name: St Panteleimon the Healer
title: Great-martyr and Unmercenary Physician
summary: A young doctor who learned that Christ is the true Physician, healed the sick for free, and was named "All-merciful" by God Himself.
sourceNote: The text for older readers follows the Life of St Panteleimon in St Dimitri of Rostov's Lives of the Saints (July 27), retold in our own English words. The sufferings are told more gently than in the original. Draft — awaiting review.

hermolaus.caption: On his way to medical school, young Pantoleon meets the old priest Hermolaus, who tells him about Christ, the true Physician.
hermolaus.alt: A street in the city of Nicomedia with tiled houses, a fountain and a fig tree. Young Pantoleon, carrying a box of medicines and scrolls, stops at the doorway of a humble house where white-bearded Father Hermolaus invites him in, while a cat sleeps on the steps and townspeople pass by.

child.caption: Pantoleon prays over a child bitten by a viper — the child gets up alive, and the viper bursts.
child.alt: On a dusty path beside a field and an olive grove, Pantoleon kneels with his hands raised in prayer beside a little boy who is sitting up, alive and surprised, while a dead snake lies in the grass. Light shines down from heaven and a shepherd's dog watches.

beasts.caption: In the arena, the wild beasts lie down gently at Panteleimon's feet like lambs.
beasts.alt: A round stone arena packed with spectators. In the middle stands Panteleimon calmly blessing, while a lion, a leopard and a bear lie at his feet and lick his hands. Some spectators raise their arms and cry out, and the angry emperor watches from his box.
